location.site_description: Switchgrass Industrial Park / US 85 area, about 8 miles south of Cheyenne; secondary coverage describes a 716-acre campus, while the official county memo does not publish parcel IDs.

status_as_of_cutoff: As of the 2026-08-11 refresh, Project Jade is now Project Tembo and is in local-process / administrative resubmittal status. Laramie County's July 8 official memo identifies Google d.b.a. Jupiter Star Holdings, LLC as the current project party after Crusoe withdrew, says prior Crusoe/Tallgrass-related zone/site-plan approvals existed, and describes a scaled-down data-center revision from five buildings / 4,025,500 sq. ft. to four buildings / 3,080,000 sq. ft. The office-complex CUP PZ-26-00057 is scheduled for an August 13, 2026 Planning Commission hearing and remains pending as of this refresh; no final revised data-center approval, building permit, CO, or energization record was verified.
evidence_grade: B: owner/project identity and local-process status are official county-sourced; 2.7 GW capacity and 716-acre campus details are supported by local/trade reporting that cites planning documents, but were not independently visible in the county memo.
